deep_dive.title: AudioLens: Multi-Perspective Speech Clustering with Reasoning Audio-Language Models
deep_dive.abstract: Audio clustering is a fundamental task for organizing rapidly growing speech collections, supporting applications such as conversational analysis and speech-driven discovery. However, existing methods rely on fixed acoustic similarity metrics or ASR-based text pipelines, limiting their ability to reorganize the same audio collection under different user-specified perspectives, especially when clustering depends on both linguistic and paralinguistic cues. We introduce audio multi-perspective clustering, where a model directly partitions speech recordings according to a natural-language perspective while inferring both the number of clusters and their assignments. To study this setting, we construct AudioLens-Bench, a benchmark spanning multiple application domains and evaluating both in-perspective and cross-perspective generalization. We further propose AudioLens-R1, an end-to-end large audio-language model trained with reasoning distillation and preference optimization. Experiments show that AudioLens-R1 consistently outperforms all baselines, improving overall ARI by 12.99 points and V-measure by 11.62 points. These results demonstrate the promise of native audio-language models for flexible, perspective-conditioned structure discovery over speech collections.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: Directly addresses clustering with LLMs: uses reasoning audio-language models to cluster speech according to natural-language perspectives, inferring cluster count and assignments.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_cn: 直接面向基于大模型的聚类：利用推理音频语言模型，根据自然语言视角对语音进行聚类并自动推断簇数与分配。
deep_dive.llm_evidence: 直接面向基于大模型的聚类：利用推理音频语言模型，根据自然语言视角对语音进行聚类并自动推断簇数与分配。

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Introduces audio multi-perspective clustering, where reasoning audio-language models partition speech recordings by natural-language perspective, inferring both cluster count and assignments, and constructs a benchmark to study this setting.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对现有语音聚类依赖固定声学相似度或ASR文本管线、难以按用户指定视角灵活重组音频集合的问题，提出音频多视角聚类任务：由推理式音频语言模型直接根据自然语言视角划分语音录音，并同时推断簇数及聚类分配。构建了AudioLens-Bench基准，验证了模型在融合语言与非语言线索进行聚类方面的能力，为基于大模型的聚类研究提供了新范式。
deep_dive.llm_tldr: 针对现有语音聚类依赖固定声学相似度或ASR文本管线、难以按用户指定视角灵活重组音频集合的问题，提出音频多视角聚类任务：由推理式音频语言模型直接根据自然语言视角划分语音录音，并同时推断簇数及聚类分配。构建了AudioLens-Bench基准，验证了模型在融合语言与非语言线索进行聚类方面的能力，为基于大模型的聚类研究提供了新范式。

deep_dive.title: Discovering Relationships in Data Lakes Using Large Language Models: An Industrial Case
deep_dive.abstract: Data lakes rely on metadata to remain usable, yet this meta data is often limited or weakly informative for column relationship discovery, especially in ERP-derived datasets with coded or abbreviated schema labels. We propose ColRel, a two-stage method that builds column embeddings from metadata and data available at ingestion time. In difficult cases, such as coded schemata, business dictionaries help better interpret column names and support the generation of short natural-language descriptions used in the second stage. Experiments on public benchmarks and an industrial ERP dataset show that ColRel is particularly effective in semantically related, weak-signal settings.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: Uses LLMs to build column embeddings for relationship discovery, effectively clustering semantically related columns.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_cn: 利用大模型构建列嵌入并生成自然语言描述，在数据湖中发现语义相关的列关系，属于基于大模型的聚类式方法。
deep_dive.llm_evidence: 利用大模型构建列嵌入并生成自然语言描述，在数据湖中发现语义相关的列关系，属于基于大模型的聚类式方法。
deep_dive.canonical_evidence: 利用大模型构建列嵌入并生成自然语言描述，在数据湖中发现语义相关的列关系，属于基于大模型的聚类式方法。
deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Proposes ColRel, a two-stage LLM-based method for column relationship discovery in data lakes. It builds column embeddings from metadata and data, and uses LLM-generated descriptions to handle coded schemata, proving effective on weak-signal industrial datasets.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 针对数据湖元数据稀疏、编码模式难以解读的问题，提出ColRel两阶段方法：先从元数据和数据中构建列嵌入，再利用大语言模型生成简短自然语言描述以辅助关系发现。在公开基准和工业ERP数据集上，该方法在语义相关的弱信号场景中尤其有效，展示了LLM增强列分组和关系挖掘的潜力。
